description: This script is a test script for merging notes trees in multiple Git worktrees. It sets up various Git references, creates worktrees, and performs merge operations to verify correct behavior in note merging scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the given input or files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

calls: git notes add -m "x notes on tantrum" tantrum
git notes add -f -m "conflicting notes on tantrum" tantrum
git notes add -f -m "more conflicting notes on tantrum" tantrum
git worktree add -b newbranch worktree main
git worktree add -b newbranch2 worktree2 main
test_grep "a notes merge into refs/notes/y is already in-progress at" err
